verdict.rationale: Ghostty's docs claim a built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts and input events, which could drive automations if an external scheduler triggered them. A hands-on runtime probe of Ghostty 1.3.1 found no remote-control or IPC interface and concluded that an external script or agent cannot send commands to or read output from a running instance, which concretely contradicts that claim. Missing for 10: any native background or scheduled automation capability, verified external scripting or IPC control, and documentation of autonomous workflows.
